structural_candidate.area_caveat: Final hub relay already exists in the parent; moving it across hierarchy requires ownership transfer, clock inventory and physical slot/pin model. No timing gain or placement fit is claimed.
structural_candidate.proof_required: Compare valid payloads/tags and finite-credit retirement with unchanged golden; invalid-cycle output switching is not a protocol transaction.
structural_candidate.power_caveat: Unconditional capture may increase switching on invalid cycles; price activity before energy claims.
